headline: Modi government proposes talks with protesters over exam leak scandal
summary: The Indian government has sent four formal proposals to the 'Cockroach' protesters demanding education reform and the resignation of the Education Minister.
details: The Modi government has proposed discussions with the 'Cockroach' protesters following demands for education reform and the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over question paper leaks.
caption:
The Indian government has offered to negotiate with student protesters over a major exam leak scandal. Will they agree to the terms?

The Modi government has proposed discussions with the 'Cockroach' protesters following demands for education reform and the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over question paper leaks.

headline: 6,165 candidates pass 50th BCS written test
summary: The Bangladesh Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the results of the written examination for the 50th BCS.
details: The Bangladesh Public Service Commission (BPSC) has officially published the results of the written examination for the 50th Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) cadre.
A total of 6,165 candidates have successfully passed the written test to move forward in the recruitment process.
Candidates can check their results online via the official BPSC website.
The successful candidates will now proceed to the next stage of the following recruitment process, which is the viva voce (oral examination).
caption:

The Bangladesh Public Service Commission (BPSC) has officially published the results of the written examination for the 50th Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) cadre.

The successful candidates will now proceed to the next stage of the following recruitment process, which is the viva voce (oral examination).
